label: GO step, committing to a1 after a rewarded common trial, later in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never D1/D2), mostly when the agent picks a1 (model_act==1 carries 95% of mass; strongest when the choice logit is above 8). GO & model_act==1 alone gives mass recall 0.95 but precision 0.40. Adding a rewarded, non-rare previous trial and ep_trial>=30 lifts precision to 0.74 (dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.85). The feature is absent before trial 10 and grows through the episode, peaking around trials 60-89. It is weak or missing on a1 GOs that follow unrewarded or rare-transition trials, and it is mostly off for a2 choices (5% of mass, small values). It is higher when the model value is moderate (5.2-7.5) and zero when value is above 8.1. Magnitude goes up with an a1-favouring choice logit and with runs of rewarded a1 trials, so it looks like an a1-commitment / reward-streak signal that builds slowly over the episode. Every variable used is observable at GO (model_act is the current choice of the agent itself).
